hypotheses.core_claim: Broad abiotic gradients directly and monotonically scale the fitness consequences of floral interactions.
hypotheses.decisive_missing_test: Manipulated abiotic gradient that reproducibly switches interaction strength across replicated Cirsium populations.

hypotheses.core_claim: Environmental context acts strongly at the seed-to-recruitment/population bottleneck, so the same fecundity effect can transmit or disappear depending on safe sites, disturbance and density dependence.
hypotheses.decisive_missing_test: Factorial focal-system test linking seed output to recruitment across manipulated microsite/disturbance or density contexts.

hypotheses.core_claim: Pollinator dependence and realized pollen limitation are decoupled by autonomous selfing, donor spacing, flowering synchrony and local density.
hypotheses.decisive_missing_test: Within-system factorial test of pollinator exclusion/supplementation across assurance contexts with final seed fitness.

hypotheses.core_claim: The relative marginal fitness contribution of pollinator-facing versus antagonist-protection traits switches across populations and times as pollination assurance and antagonist pressure change. High assurance can flatten extra-attraction benefits; low assurance can restore strong pollinator-mediated selection, while antagonist-mediated selection depends on enemy pressure and defence effectiveness.
hypotheses.decisive_missing_test: Same populations and same fitness scale measuring marginal pollination benefit and marginal antagonist cost across crossed gradients of pollination assurance and antagonist pressure.

hypotheses.core_claim: Floral modules can mitigate mutualist-antagonist conflict by partitioning exposure in time, space or sensory channels rather than settling at a static compromise.
hypotheses.decisive_missing_test: Cirsium manipulation showing unchanged total visitation but shifted timing/effective contacts or enemy exposure and higher reproductive fitness.

hypotheses.core_claim: Different capitulum modules may act on different ecological gates and vary semi-independently, but a common-lability full model remains viable.
hypotheses.decisive_missing_test: Ancestry-controlled multivariate field data showing module-specific trait->interaction/protection->fitness paths and comparing shared versus module-specific random-effect structures.

interpretation.weakened: A simple broad-gradient direct-scaling model is contradicted by several independent Cirsium tests and by the structural screen.
interpretation.working_support: Demographic gating and reproductive-assurance buffering have repeated direct Cirsium support and are ready to become explicit focal-system predictions.
interpretation.new_candidates: An assurance-dependent mutualist-antagonist selection mosaic and interaction partitioning are generated by the combined meta-syntheses but are not yet identified causal conclusions.
interpretation.central_unresolved: Multi-stage modularity remains unresolved because both module-specific and common-lability full models can reproduce important targets.

claim_boundary: This is a preregistered-style falsification audit over heterogeneous existing evidence, not a meta-analytic effect-size model, Bayes factor, posterior probability, or vote-counting proof.
